sections.Profile:
The "Atlantis" pinball machine, released by Bally in 1989, is a solid-state game designed by Peter Perry with artwork by Pat McMahon. This game features an underwater theme set in the mythical city of Atlantis, enhanced by vibrant artwork and engaging gameplay elements.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1989
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Water Sports, Myth and Legend, Ocean, Fish, Original Theme, Underwater, Solid State, Water, Fantasy, 1980s
